???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call a family of operations, types and attributes that MLIR ships as one unit, such as linalg or arith?"

        A dialect. One MLIR module can mix several dialects at once, all handled by the same parser, verifier and printer.

        Introduced in [M1. Why MLIR](m1-why-mlir.md).

    ??? question "What is a straight run of instructions with one way in at the top and one way out at the bottom called?"

        A basic block. Nothing jumps into the middle of it.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "In SSA form, what picks which version of a value to use at a point where two paths meet?"

        A phi. Its choice depends on which path was taken.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "Which v0.1 type holds a fixed number of values of one type, with sizes known at compile time, such as `[f32; 4]`?"

        A fixed-size array. Its element type and every dimension are part of its type.

        Introduced in [Learn: 4. Variables and types](../language-tour/04-variables-and-types.md). Specification: [7. Arrays and shapes](../specification/arrays.md#71-array-types).

    ??? question "How can a function read or change an existing value without copying it, and how are the two kinds written?"

        Through a reference. `&T` is a shared reference for reading; `&mut T` is a mutable reference that can also change the value.

        Introduced in [Learn: 4. Variables and types](../language-tour/04-variables-and-types.md). Specification: [9. References and mutability](../specification/references.md#91-reference-types).
